HidrateSpark Health Sync requests write-only access to hydration and Nearby Devices access for your bottle. It stores sip time and volume locally, writes those records to Health Connect, and does not read other health data. It has no Internet permission, analytics, advertising, cloud service, or Home Assistant dependency.
